name: opencode
description: Installs opencode CLI on Wolfi base images.

version.description: Select the opencode CLI version to install.

copyAuth.description: Whether to copy opencode auth.json from the host into the container.

initializeCommand: sh -c 'SRC="$HOME/.local/share/opencode/auth.json"; DEST="${localWorkspaceFolder}/.opencode-auth.json"; if [ -f "$SRC" ]; then cp "$SRC" "$DEST"; else printf "{}" > "$DEST"; fi; chmod 600 "$DEST"'
